description: Synthetic engineering benchmark for cross-layer change assurance; not a claim of production generalization.
anti_gaming_rules: Never report PASS if mandatory evidence is absent or stale.
Report raw counts and unsupported cases for every tool.
Do not compare metrics derived from different datasets as if they were directly comparable.
Publish every case where the full-suite oracle could not establish ground truth.
Report time reduction together with regression detection and false-block rate.
